paragraphs.text: The Great Forest of Lorwyn is a seemingly endless expanse of stout-trunked oaks and other mighty trees.

It is a grove of the Rising , a protected birthplace of treefolk . Some of Lorwyn's most famous treefolk warriors and shamans , such as Doran , the Siege Tower, originated here. The Murmuring Bosk and Wren's Run are part of the Great Forest.
Its Shadowmoor equivalent is possibly the Creakwood .
